_description: Central mapping of media types to default Output-Configs
_note: DevServer uses this to determine which Output-Config to use for auto-media generation
_architecture: Separation of concerns: text manipulation configs suggest media type, this file chooses which model/config
_video_note: Was 'wan22_t2v_diffusers' until 2026-09-07, which is no config at all — corrected to the one Wan text-to-video config there is. Latent until the medium is inferred rather than chosen; from then on it decides every video run nobody picked a model for.
